u3._uninstallDoc: PLACEHOLDER — Sérgio voice pass pending. THE DISPERSAL (E2 script S2R.7; D31 STRUCK by Sérgio 2026-07-25 after the GPAHE check, with refinements — docs/REINTERP_D31_DISPERSAL_EVIDENCE_2026-07-25.md). The program's collapse doesn't kill the watcher; it renames it. The uninstall report renders AFTER the changelog finishes typing; lines prefixed '~' draw small and dim (the quiet line carries the thesis). Under the report LAMBY HIMSELF comes apart into seven small marks — the same seven src/desktop/theme/era3.ts's drawLambMark renders SETTLED as Lambient's badge on Room 2's three screens at E3, so what leaves here is literally what arrives there. Built by Fable, Session 33; re-staged and re-worded Session 58. WHY 'RENAMED' AND NOT 'MIGRATING' (Sérgio's adopted refinement): renaming is the documented mechanism — NARTH became ATCSI in 2014, and GPAHE 2023 finds providers relabelling in medical-sounding language to evade moderation. An uninstaller that reports success while the process continues under a new label is better sourced than vague migration AND it rhymes with the piece's own update-as-survival grammar. FRAMING DISCIPLINE (binding): this is survival by scattering, never omnipotence — GPAHE 2023 finds deplatforming partly WORKED, so the staging keeps the marks few, small, and settled, and the fiction keeps its invented marks (Restorify → GracePlatform); the real companies GPAHE names belong to dossier/provenance surfaces only, never to a room.

_dispersalGrounding.text: Documentary grounding for the dispersal: after Exodus International's closure (announced 19 June 2013) the movement survived by rebranding (softer messaging, new names), decentralizing from centralized structures into networks of independent affiliates, and migrating into platform-native forms. The specific RENAMING mechanism is documented: NARTH became ATCSI in 2014, and providers adopt medical-sounding terminology to evade content moderation. Contested-ground caveat that must travel with the claim: GPAHE's 2023 report finds deplatforming partly worked (Facebook/Instagram recommendation pathways eliminated, Bing markedly improved, TikTok best-performing with warnings; YouTube still poor, non-English content least moderated). S76 REWROTE u4: the last update the piece installs, and the one the title is about. Three things had to land in it. (1) ⚑ L ARRIVES INSIDE IT — the `report` block below installs the companion, so L is something AGREED TO in a dialog nobody read, not a character who appears. (2) ⚑ THE EULA IS WHERE THE SOURCE PASS LANDS (docs/REINTERP_E4_SOURCE_PASS_2026-08-06.md): no conversion-practice organisation was found building or commissioning AI tooling — an individual built the tool and an organisation promoted it. The apparatus is an ADOPTER, not a developer. That finding is page 3, clause 3, in supplier boilerplate: 'does not develop, train or host the models it makes available. It accepts their terms on your behalf, as you accept these on your own.' A player who reads the terms finds it; a player who clicks through does not; ⚑ NOTHING ANYWHERE POINTS AT IT. Do not add emphasis, a colour, or a line that draws the eye — the whole beat is that it is legally disclosed and practically invisible. (3) The changelog is the thesis and the thesis is the LABOUR: what this update removes is the person doing the work (E3 = Vera correcting testimony by hand, one correction at a time; E4 = the same operation with nobody's hands on it). ⚑ Every mark is invented — GracePlatform is the piece's own E3 platform, Continuity and Sunroom are ours. No real company, product, model or organisation is named in the fiction, ever; the documented ones live on Dossier cards with a status.
